name: Whirlpool China Co., Ltd.
summary: Whirlpool China Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, procurement, production, and sale of kitchen appliances in China and internationally. The company offers washing machines, refrigerators, microwave ovens, bidets, air purifiers, electronic program controllers, clutches, motors, controllers, induction cookers, electric ovens, rice cookers, toasters, bread machines, coffee machines, espresso machines, electric baking pans, coffee grinders, yogurt machines, sandwich makers, electric kettles, and electric water bottles.
